p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 1000000007
u = [0] * (2 * 10**6 + 7)
ans = 1

def dfs(v):
    global u
    u[v] = 1
    x = (k * v) % p
    if not u[x]:
        dfs(x)

i = 0 if k == 1 else 1
for i in range(i, p):
    if not u[i]:
        dfs(i)
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
print(ans)
</translated_code>
